name: data-table
description: Create a sortable, filterable data table component

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript DataTable generic class that can display, sort, and filter data. Include proper interfaces and generic types.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript DataTable class that can display, sort, and filter data.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript DataTable class with JSDoc that can display, sort, and filter data. Include generic type annotations.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Create a data table component with sorting and filtering in vanilla JavaScript. Include:

**Features:**
- Display data in a table
- Column headers with sort indicators (↑↓)
- Click header to sort (ascending/descending/no sort)
- Search/filter input (filters all columns)
- Pagination (rows per page: 10, 25, 50)
- Row selection (checkbox)
- Responsive design

**HTML Structure:**
- Search input
- Table with thead and tbody
- Pagination controls
- Rows per page selector

**CSS:**
- Clean table design
- Striped rows
- Hover effects
- Sort indicators
- Mobile responsive (horizontal scroll on small screens)

**JavaScript:**
- DataTable class
- Methods: setData(), sort(), filter(), paginate()
- Event handlers for interactions
- Efficient re-rendering

**Sample Data:** Use user data (id, name, email, role, status)

Return as single HTML file with demo data.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Same as javascript-vanilla-web, plus complete JSDoc:

- @typedef for Column definition
- @typedef for TableConfig
- @typedef for DataRow (generic)
- Document all methods
- Include usage examples in JSDoc

Return as single HTML file.
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Create a data table using TypeScript and vanilla Web APIs. Include:

**TypeScript:**
- Generic DataTable<T> class
- Interface for Column<T> (key, header, sortable, formatter)
- Interface for TableConfig
- Type-safe sorting and filtering
- Proper event typing

**Features:**
- Generic data type support
- Column configuration (sortable, formatter function)
- Multi-column sorting
- Global and per-column filtering
- Pagination
- Row selection
- Custom cell rendering

**Code Structure:**
- Separate TypeScript modules
- Clean separation of concerns
- No frameworks

Provide TypeScript source, HTML structure, and usage example.
variants.typescript-react:
Create a data table component using TypeScript React. Include:

**Components:**
- DataTable<T> (generic component)
- TableHeader
- TableBody
- TableRow
- TablePagination
- TableFilters

**TypeScript:**
- Generic component: DataTable<T>
- Column<T> interface (key, header, sortable, render?)
- TableProps<T> interface
- Type-safe sorting and filtering

**Features:**
- Generic data type support
- Sortable columns (multi-sort with shift-click)
- Global search
- Per-column filters
- Pagination
- Row selection (controlled/uncontrolled)
- Custom cell renderers
- Loading state
- Empty state

**Example:**
```tsx
interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
}

const columns: Column<User>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', sortable: true }
];

<DataTable<User> data={users} columns={columns} />
```

Use React hooks, no external table libraries.
